_comment: EXP-1162: THE detail chrome, identical x4 (web lib/detail-chrome.ts, desktop domain::detail_chrome, iOS ExpCore DetailChrome, Android domain/DetailChrome). Points (web px = desktop px = iOS pt = Android dp). TITLE COLLAPSE: the issue face keeps its large title as a ROW of the scrolling content; the header shows the identifier alone until that row has scrolled away, then BREAKS (a threshold, never a progressive morph) into the collapsed title: the mono identifier (small, muted) over the title on ONE truncated line, fading in over `collapseMs` while rising `collapseRise`. `collapsed = !hasTitleRow || titleBottom <= headerBottom` (both in the same coordinate space, the header band's bottom edge incl. the face tabs). A face with no title row of its own (Run, Changes, Results) is ALWAYS collapsed. EDGE STRIPS: content scrolls UNDER the header band and the floating bottom bar. The header band is the page background at `scrim` alpha over a `edgeBlur` blur, no hairline; below it a strip `edgeTop` tall fades both the scrim and the blur to nothing. At the bottom a strip from the screen edge to `edgeBottom` above the bar's top fades the same way upwards. A client that cannot blur what is behind a view (desktop gpui) paints the band OPAQUE, since unblurred text would read through the scrim, and keeps the fades; Android below API 31 falls back to its blur library's scrim. FACE MARKS (EXP-1162): the header TITLE carries NO state dot on any client; state lives on the face tabs, and `faceDots` says which tab carries which tone. The RUN tab never draws a dot: while its run is LIVE it wears the run's AGENT BRAND MARK (claude / codex, the generic agents glyph for an unknown agent), the very mark the sidebar's Running rows and the session screen draw. It LEADS the tab's label, `faceMark` points, `faceMarkGap` before the label; tone `needs_input` adds the Running row's amber badge (`faceMarkBadge` points, top trailing corner of the mark); while the agent is mid-turn (the synced `agent_busy`) the mark beats like the session screen's working mark (reduced motion: steady). An ended run wears no mark. An OPEN pull request puts a `review` DOT on the Results tab, or on the Changes tab when there is no Results face: `faceDot` points wide, trailing the label by `faceDotGap`. Tones are the session-dot table's (x4). A face that is not on show carries nothing.

collapse.name: the title row sits below the header
one point of the title still shows
the title's bottom edge meets the header's: it breaks
a face with no title row is always collapsed
a title row not measured yet stays expanded

faceDots.name: no run and no pull request: no dots
a live run dots the Run tab
a run waiting on a person dots the Run tab amber
an ended run carries no dot, even if it still says needs input
an open pull request dots Results
an open pull request with no Results face dots Changes
a live run with an open pull request dots both
an open pull request with neither face shows no dot
an issue-less run dots its Run tab too
